data.explanation: Your housing cooperative (Genossenschaft) has assigned you the apartment at Siedlungsweg 18, ground floor right, starting 1 January 2027, and sent you the usage contract (Nutzungsvertrag) in two copies. Sign both copies and send one back to the cooperative by the deadline shown (counted in working days from the letter's date, Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays). The letter doesn't say what happens if you miss this, so contact the cooperative if you can't return it in time. Keep the second signed copy for your own records.
